text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Renewables must be integrated into the Swiss energy system in order to ensure that demand is met; storage is available where and when needed; energy conversion is efficient, climate-neutral and net-negative.", "gist": "Renewables integration is required for meeting demand, providing storage, and achieving efficient, climate-neutral, net-negative energy conversion in Switzerland."}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "in such a way as to be of optimum value to the Swiss economy and society and also form part of the overall European energy system", "gist": "Integration must maximize economic and societal value for Switzerland and align with the broader European energy system"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "13", "gist": "Number of applications submitted"}, {"type": "date", "quote": "25 June to 12 October 2020", "gist": "Duration of the SWEET Call 1-2020"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "SWEET Call 1-2020", "gist": "A specific funding or research call program"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "CROSS", "gist": "The top-ranked consortium selected for the research challenge"}]}
